scope: Exact original UTF-8 records for tested source 47345c81db8aefbf9ae51a2684d546119bb9ae32: complete finalized per-route and all-miss audit reports, native full LastTest/JUnit and timing receipts, original small installer/security logs, four independently acquired release bundles, all 128 native final-gate checks with raw evidence, source/publication and completed-run proof, actual package/hash/index audits and independent cross-reviews. limitations: Complete callback CSV populations, executables, packages, ZIP containers, MSIX, DEB/tar payloads, signature/audio/image snapshots and the 6,362,501-byte lifecycle trace are not embedded. Their available original integrity receipts, file indexes and complete audit summaries are selected instead.

Every selected record is an exact UTF-8 decode/encode round trip with SHA-256. No original log or receipt has been normalized. Signed or ephemeral download URLs are excluded.

Two optional intermediate Windows validation release-gate.md files are not valid UTF-8 and are omitted as byte bodies. Their exact original hashes, UTF-8 error, file indexes and corresponding JSON reports are retained. All 154 files of the separate final native gate and all four original release bundles are included.

Final release policy remains BLOCKED: 21 PASS and 107 NOT_EXECUTED checks, with zero producer errors. Native tests and package-byte audits do not certify unexecuted policy checks, release publication, trusted publisher signing/notarization or unperformed macOS/Linux installation and hardware/DAW use.

Actual five package hashes are independently bound to assembly checksums and three update assets. The redundant combined Release-Candidate ZIP container was not downloaded or independently byte-verified.

The retained Windows Setup partial is an exact 90,177,536-byte prefix of the verified complete ZIP. Its cause is unresolved and it does not establish the total HTTP request count. Its observation and original helper completion output are selected, while partial payload bytes are excluded.
Baseline, separate diagnostic profile, Candidate and Product evidence retain their original labels and populations. Their samples are not spliced into a new acceptance result.
